schema: fab-checklist-final rows; every cell is {short, value, verdict, reason, source}. No blanks, no TBD.
supersedes: fab-checklist-v6/rows.json (same 13 evidence columns and verdict rules; every cell that the settled wave-18 state changed has been re-derived)

verdict_rules.copper: PASS iff the stackup matches the board's declared weight on every copper layer; a rail capacity may be quoted here only as a derived figure with its k and its rule
verdict_rules.min_track: PASS iff min track >= the pattern rule for the declared weight (1 oz 0.100, 3 oz 0.200, 4 oz 0.250)
verdict_rules.min_space: PASS iff the MINIMUM measured clearance >= the rule for the declared weight; the pair count is never charged (it does not reproduce)
verdict_rules.min_drill: PASS iff min via drill >= 0.200 (no HDI) AND min PTH drill >= the finished-hole floor at the declared weight
verdict_rules.min_ring: PASS iff the smallest ring >= the published floor for the weight; WAIVED iff below that floor but at or above the board's own rule, priced as a quote line
verdict_rules.nonthrough: PASS iff blind + buried == 0, classified by LAYER PAIR (span), never by drill diameter or declared type
verdict_rules.unconnected: PASS iff pcbnew GetUnconnectedCount(False) == 0 and the count is not at a tool cap; a kicad-cli count of exactly 499 is its cap
verdict_rules.drc: PASS iff 0 errors at the right rules for the weight AND the fab-real count (reported + DRC-invisible population) is 0. A count measured on a COPY is named as a copy
verdict_rules.package: PASS iff a package exists, reconciles, is an export of the shipped part, and carries 0 blind/buried drill files
verdict_rules.revision: PASS iff the part or board carries a non-empty revision and the package agrees with it
verdict_rules.outline: PASS iff the outline polygon closes and the area (or volume, for a solid) is > 0
verdict_rules.finish: PASS iff the copper_finish field is populated; WAIVED where no PCB and no finish callout exist
verdict_rules.orderable: YES iff 0 FAIL cells. A WAIVED cell is a priced quote line or an n/a column, never a defect
verdict_rules.blocking: the single measured number that stops an order today; for a NO row it must occur verbatim in a FAIL cell; for a YES row it must be 0
